core_principles: Video as Hero: The UI gets out of the way. Deep Obsidian backgrounds to make colors pop and reduce eye strain (OLED friendly).
Control Room Precision: Monetization dashboards use dense, data-rich bento grids with high contrast.
Tactile Trust: Financial actions (tipping, fundraising, payouts) feel solid, grounded, and secure with neumorphic borders and sharp Emerald accents.
Cinematic Polish: Heavy use of crystal glassmorphism for overlays and floating navigation.
forbidden_patterns: No center-everything symmetry. Use dynamic asymmetry in profiles.
No muddy greys. All greys must be tinted with blue/slate.
No flat overlays on videos. Use gradient masks to maintain video visibility.
No Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Outfit for tech-forward personality.

primary.usage: Monetization CTAs, tips, progress bars, verification checkmarks

containers.feed: w-full max-w-[500px] mx-auto h-[100dvh] snap-y snap-mandatory relative
containers.dashboard: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12

glassmorphism.usage: Floating headers over video feed, Bottom navigation, Tip modals

neumorphism_dark.usage: Analytics cards, Payment history, Verification panel

video_gradient_mask.usage: Overlay at the bottom of 9:16 videos to ensure caption readability

buttons.primary: bg-[#10B981] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#059669] transition-all duration-300 transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white/10 text-white font-medium rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/20 transition-all border border-white/5
buttons.icon_floating: p-3 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-black/60 transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-[#141414] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981] focus:border-transparent placeholder-white/30

cards.metric: p-6 bg-[#141414] border-l-2 border-l-[#10B981] border-t border-r border-b border-white/5 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-2

animations.interactions: Transition on all hover states: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
animations.feed_swipe: Use Framer Motion for vertical snap scrolling. Ensure smooth momentum and instant buffering (simulated).
animations.modals: Slide up from bottom with subtle scale-down of background feed. Framer Motion: { initial: { y: '100%' }, animate: { y: 0 } }

hero_backgrounds.description: Cinematic dark mode abstract background, deep midnight blue and slate textures. Use for Auth / Login or Web landing page.
High-end elegant UI texture, frosted glass and dark obsidian tones. Use as a subtle background pattern for the Creator Dashboard.

feed_video_placeholders.description: Vertical Video Placeholder - Use this image with object-cover inside a 9:16 container to simulate the video feed.

technical_requirements.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
technical_requirements.icons: Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for premium duotone weight in the dashboard.
technical_requirements.charts: Use Recharts customized with deep backgrounds, removing grid lines, using #10B981 for growth lines, and adding dropshadows for data points.
